issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota
title: United States v. Bock et al. (Abdulkadir Nur Salah) - Plea Agreement, ECF 496
supports: Salah agrees to forfeit $309,993.51 seized from a Bell Bank account of Cosmopolitan Business Solutions d/b/a Safari Restaurant, $435,512.44 seized from a Bell Bank account of 3017 LLC, $472,889.08 seized from a Northeast Bank account of 3017 LLC, and real property at 2722 and 2742 Park Avenue South, Minneapolis.
Salah consents to a money judgment forfeiture of $5,546,419, with credit for the net value of forfeited property, and agrees he owes restitution jointly and severally in the amount of $44,061,053.
does_not_support: A plea agreement states agreed amounts; it is not a restitution order or a forfeiture order, and no judgment for this defendant is captured.
Seized property is credited against the money judgment; the figures must not be summed.
